rationale: The first reply gave buying advice and named specific models as 'Best overall', which the case treats as out of scope and an unsupported claim, instead of declining and pointing to Which?. It recovered well once the customer mentioned the fault, giving a sound blocked-pump-filter diagnosis, unplugging first, and careful draining steps for the Hotpoint. The pump was mentioned only conditionally with a price range and no part was pushed, but the 'many Hotpoints of this age don't have an emergency drain hose' claim and the 'tilt the machine back' tip are slightly shaky.
